name: Autophix DM5600 Automotive Diagnostic Tool
short_description:
• Support all VAG series vehicles, the DM5600 is the handiest diagnostic tool for professional working with road vehicles.
  • Providing both basic functions like fault codes, as well as special functions like service reset.
  • This tool supports all OBDII protocols and works on most 2000 and newer OBDII compliant vehicles across three major territories; OBDII functions include reading and erasing codes.
  • The DM5600 comes with 7+ menu langues including English, French, and Spanish.
description:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]The 5600 automotive diagnostic tool support road vehicles; with a focus on VAG group including VW, Audi, Skoda, SEAT and others.

Operating Voltage is 8V ~ 18V

Operating Temperature is 0C ~ 60C (32~140F)

Storage Temperature is -20C ~ 70C (-4~158F)

Basic Functions For Vehicles

  • Version Information
  • Read Fault Codes
  • Erase Fault Codes
  • Read Data stream(Only the engine, transmission, ABS, and airbag systems have data stream)

Special Functions For VAG Vehicles

  • Service reset
  • Throttle Learning
  • EPB Replace Brake Pads
  • Tire Pressure Reset (TPMS)
  • Battery Registration

Diagnostic Coverage

  • Supports all OBDII protocols (CAN, J1850 PWM, J1850VPW, IS09141 and KWP 2000) and all V/W Diagnostic protocols (KWP1281, KWP 2000, TP-CAN, UDS)
  • Works on most 2000 and newer OBDII compliant US, European and Asian vehicles.

OBDII Functions

  • Read Codes
  • Erase Codes
  • I/M Readiness
  • Data Stream
  • Vehicle Information

Optional Multilingual Menu Interface

English, French, Spanish, German, Russian, Swedish, Portuguese, Finnish

Additional Information

Free software upgrades are available direct from Autophix. Simply connect the DM5600 to your computer via USB. This service is only supported on Windows 7/8/10/11, not MAC OS.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]
